description: Source code for the ST Microelectronics STTS751 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, data fetching, configuration, and API registration.

methods.name: stts751_set_odr_raw
methods.description: Sets the raw output data rate for the sensor.

methods.name: stts751_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a sample from the sensor and updates internal data.

methods.name: stts751_temp_convert
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: stts751_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the temperature value for a specified channel.

methods.name: stts751_odr_set
methods.description: Sets the output data rate based on sensor_value input.

methods.name: stts751_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as sampling frequency.

methods.name: stts751_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes the sensor chip, verifies ID, sets default configurations.

methods.name: stts751_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, including bus and interrupt setup.
